Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms

Class StartPhoneEnrolmentUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms.StartPhoneEnrolmentUseCase
@Service @Transactional public class StartPhoneEnrolmentUseCase extends Object
Starts the enrolment of a phone: normalises the number and sends it a verification code.

What may be visible and what may not: an invalid number (InvalidPhoneNumberException) and a country that is not served (SmsCountryNotAllowedException) depend on the input alone and reveal nothing about any account, so they fail visibly. Everything that depends on the state of other accounts or of the system is indistinguishable from success: a number already verified by another user (no message is sent, no state is stored, but the same work is done), an exhausted SMS budget and a provider failure (the message is sent after the transaction commits, off the request thread, by the delivery of SmsRequested, which records a failure without the number or the code). Otherwise an attacker could learn which numbers belong to accounts.
